observations: Selecting the largest-magnitude nonzero frequencies minimizes the residual L2 energy for fixed K.
Using three exact major frequencies increased successful channel certificates from 419 to 6749 on the declared benchmark.
No false prime-channel certificate was observed.
The remaining gap to 15833 prime-positive channels shows that the uniform L2 minor bound is still not sharp enough for all channels.
These are finite computational results, not an asymptotic major-arc or minor-arc estimate.
